title: REpeat Intervention for Failed Surgical BioProsthEtic AorTic Valves (REPEAT): A Multicenter Randomized Trial Comparing Redo Surgical Aortic Valve Replacement to Valve-in-Valve Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement
summary: This study compares two procedures for the treatment of biological aortic valve prostheses that no longer function adequately due to wear and tear. Repeated surgical replacement and catheter-based implantation of a stent prosthesis in the worn valve are compared.
